name: Linear Wipe
description: Shows the picture behind a straight soft edge that sweeps across it; the rest is transparent. Drive `progress` from 0 (nothing) to 1 (the whole picture).

params.name: angle
params.description: Direction the edge moves in, degrees: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom

params.name: softness
params.description: Edge width, part of the sweep
